batch_size: Number of samples processed in a batch. If not specified, it will be adjusted to the available GPU memory, with a minimum of 6 and a maximum of 24
min_particle_size: Minimum size (in pixels) for connected components. Objects smaller than this threshold are removed
separation: Instance segmentation of objects such as cells or rock particles
refinement: Refine segmentation on full resolution data
ignore_mask: Use a binary mask in the second channel of the label file to define ignored (0) and considered (1) areas during training
downsample: Downsampling to the smaller group when using balance
network_filters: Number of filters per layer up to the deepest
optimizer: Optimizer used for training. If adam is used, please reduce learning_rate to 0.0001

doc:
This script uses Biomedisa tool from https://biomedisa.info/
Available in 2D and 3D.

Available functions for 3D processing :
    process_volume

Modules Required : biomedisa, zarr, torch, torchvision, scikit_image,
                   medpy, numba, importlib_metadata, cv2, matplotlib,
                   mpi4py, keras, pycuda/pyopencl (depending on your gpu)

Models are assumed to be stored under assets/models directory.

To install biomedisa on Windows -
Have a look at https://biomedisa.info/
https://github.com/biomedisa/biomedisa/blob/master/README/windows.md

Install Cuda (for nvidia gpu) and OpenCL (for other gpu)
If you don't have Visual Studio - Install visual studio cpp build tools - https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/visual-cpp-build-tools/
Install msmpisetup.exe from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/message-passing-interface/microsoft-mpi

uv pip install numba
uv pip install zarr
uv pip install numpy
uv pip install pycuda (for nvidia)  pyopencl (otherwise)
uv pip install mpi4py
uv Install pytorch from https://pytorch.org/
uv pip install keras
uv pip install scikit_image
uv pip install medpy
uv pip install importlib_metadata
uv pip install opencv-python
uv pip install matplotlib
uv pip install biomedisa

Install Segment Anything Model (SAM) for instance segmentation
uv pip install git+https://github.com/facebookresearch/segment-anything.git
